subject: Field type uuid not recognized by RS-DBI driver for PostgreSQL

messages.author: cf98ec64431c34d5
messages.subject: Field type uuid not recognized by RS-DBI driver for PostgreSQL
parts:
Not sure where to file an issue for this. I have a table with field type uuid (http://www.postgresql.org/docs/9.4/static/datatype-uuid.html) which generates this warning when I connect to it:

Warning messages:
1: In postgresqlExecStatement(conn, statement, ...) :
  RS-DBI driver warning: (unrecognized PostgreSQL field type uuid (id:2950) in column 0)


Thanks.
